record.original_question: Is a cubic fourfold X rational if and only if its Kuznetsov component Ku(X) is equivalent to the bounded derived category of a K3 surface?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.16 (Kuznetsov). A cubic fourfold X is rational if and only if Ku(X) is equivalent to the bounded derived category of a K3 surface.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^5_{\mathbb{C}}$ be a smooth cubic fourfold, i.e., a smooth hypersurface of degree $3$ in complex projective five-space. The bounded derived category of coherent sheaves $D^b(X)$ admits a semiorthogonal decomposition
$$D^b(X) = \langle \mathrm{Ku}(X),\; \mathcal{O}_X,\; \mathcal{O}_X(1),\; \mathcal{O}_X(2) \rangle,$$
where the Kuznetsov component $\mathrm{Ku}(X)$ is defined as the full triangulated subcategory
$$\mathrm{Ku}(X) = \{ E \in D^b(X) : \mathrm{Ext}^\bullet(\mathcal{O}_X(i), E) = 0 \text{ for } i = 0, 1, 2 \}.$$
The category $\mathrm{Ku}(X)$ is a $\mathbb{C}$-linear triangulated category with Serre functor equal to the shift $[2]$ and with Hochschild homology equal to that of a K3 surface, so it is a "noncommutative K3 surface."

Recall that $X$ is said to be rational if there exists a birational map $X \dashrightarrow \mathbb{P}^4$ over $\mathbb{C}$.

Prove or disprove: $X$ is rational if and only if there exists a smooth projective K3 surface $S$ over $\mathbb{C}$ together with a $\mathbb{C}$-linear exact equivalence of triangulated categories $\mathrm{Ku}(X) \simeq D^b(S)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Kuznetsov's conjecture remains open. Neither implication has been proven in general. Addington–Thomas showed it is generically equivalent to Hassett's period-theoretic conjecture characterizing rational cubic fourfolds. Rationality is known for generic cubics in certain Hassett divisors (e.g., $\mathcal{C}_{14}, \mathcal{C}_{26}, \mathcal{C}_{38}, \mathcal{C}_{42}$), consistent with the conjecture but not resolving it.

status_evidence.title: Kuznetsov's conjecture and rationality of cubic fourfolds (Stagliano slides)
status_evidence.snippet: Neither of the two implications of Kuznetsov's conjecture has been verified until now, although Addington and Thomas have shown that the conjecture is (generically) equivalent to Hassett's conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture remains unproven in both directions, with a known generic equivalence to Hassett's conjecture.

status_evidence.title: The K3 category of a cubic fourfold — an update (Huybrechts)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing the Kuznetsov component Ku(X) of a cubic fourfold and its conjectural relation to rationality via equivalence with D^b(K3).
status_evidence.claim: Recent surveys treat the equivalence Ku(X) ≃ D^b(K3) ⇔ rationality of X as an open conjecture.
